enacted as follows VIII of 1878:‑

THE EXCISE (MALT LIQUORS) ACT, 1890
THE EXCISE (MALT LIQUORS) ACT, 1890
Act No. XIII of 1890
[28th
March, 1890]
An Act (The words
"to amend the Excise Act, 1881, and the Bengal Excise Act, 1878, and"
rep. by the Repealing and Amending Act, 1914 (10 of 1914).)* * * to apply to Malt Liquor certain
provisions of the Sea Customs Act, 1878, respecting spirit.
WHEREAS it is
expedient (The
words "to amend the Excise Act, 1881, and the Bengal Excise Act, 1878,
and" rep. by the Repealing and Amending Act, 1914 (10 of 1914).)* * * to apply to malt liquor certain
provisions of the Sea Customs, Act, 1878, respecting spirit; It is hereby
enacted as follows VIII of 1878:‑
Drawback of Excise‑duty on Export of Malt Liquor
9. Application of provisions of section 150, Act,
VIII, 1878, to malt liquor. The provisions of
section 150 of the Sea Customs Act, 1878, with respect to the allowance of a
drawback of excise‑duty paid on spirit manufactured in (Subs. by Ord.
21 of 1960, s. 3 and 2nd Sch. (with effect from the 14th October, 1955), for
"the Provinces and the Capital of the Federation" which had been
subs. by A. O. 1949, Arts. 3(2) and 4, for "British India .) [Pakistan] and exported to a foreign
port, and with respect to the regulation of the drawback by the quantity of
such spirit, shall apply also, so far as they can be made applicable, to
fermented liquor made in (Subs. by Ord. 21 of 1960, s. 3 and 2nd Sch. (with effect from
the 14th October, 1955), for "the Provinces and the Capital of the
Federation" which had been subs. by A. O. 1949, Arts. 3(2) and 4, for
"British India .)
[Pakistan] from malt and so exported and to the drawback of the excise‑duty
paid on such liquor.
